title.narrative: Supporting the Promotion of a More Equitable, Sustainable and Safer Education in Haiti

description.narrative: In support of the Promoting a More Equitable, Sustainable and Safer Education Project (PROMESSE), funded by the World Bank, expected to benefit about 150,000 students in Haiti, this project aims to provide assistance to the Ministry of National Education and Vocational Training (MENFP) of Haiti, to improve its information system. UNOPS assists the ministry in its data collection in more than 800 schools in terms of collection, training and development of technological tools for the activity.
